title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts and docs updates
author: Liam Chen
description: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to the docs site and examples repo. Motivation: provide engineers with production-ready quickstarts for common RAG + agent workflows (search-backed QA, multi-tool agents, step-by-step tool calling patterns) to reduce onboarding time and prevent regressions when upgrading the runtime. This PR includes new quickstart pages, three runnable example projects under redwood-examples, updated sidebar/navigation entries on the docs site, and small SDK helper additions to simplify tool registration. Checklist: add quickstart pages; add example repos (node + python + toy service); add RAG template YAMLs and agent manifest examples; add docs site nav entries and redirects; add unit/integration tests for examples; verify CI and deploy preview. Related Linear tasks: ENG-3812, PM-722. Notes: examples are intentionally small and use the public demo index; production users should replace with their own vector store and credentials.
